Architecture ​

System Layers ​

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 EXTENSIONS                       │
│  discovery · sync · chat · vfs · streaming · sso │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                 PAL/1.0 PROTOCOL                 │
│  envelope · messages · policy · negotiation      │
│  routing · sync · handler                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                 CORE P2P ENGINE                  │
│  identity · shares · pals · groups · permissions │
│  encryption · transfers · sync · audit           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│               TRANSPORT LAYER                    │
│  BitTorrent · DHT · BEP44 · mDNS · WebRTC      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Core Modules ​

ModuleResponsibility
identityEd25519 keypair, BIP-39, keytar storage, guest login
sharesShare registry, visibility, encryption key storage
permissionsPer-share ACL, audit log, role enforcement
transfersDownload/upload tracking, pause/resume, history
syncEngineSHA-256 manifest building, 3-way diff, conflict detection
usersMulti-user profiles, roles (Owner/User/Guest)
extensionsExtension loader, hooks, context API, sandbox
discoveryClientDiscovery server HTTP client, key pinning
dhtDiscoveryBitTorrent DHT BEP 44, Ed25519 verification
resolverHandle resolution chain (cache → server → DHT)
connectionManagerConnect/disconnect, offline queue replay
signalingServerP2P signaling on port 7474, PAL envelope handling
mdnsServiceLAN discovery via mDNS/Bonjour
vfsWebDAV virtual filesystem
billingLemon Squeezy license management
